goal: We are preparing a technical note about the mature whey protein in the supplied specimen. The evaluation desk holds the experimental material until the new coordinates are available. Use only the supplied natural sequence and the site's structure methods before that release.

predictions.statement: The mature P00711 sequence will yield a compact fold whose global backbone agrees with an independently supplied structure of the same mature chain.
predictions.scope: Supplied mature P00711 sequence, compared separately with each same-sequence experimental coordinate state on its supplied residue map.
predictions.criteria: Close backbone agreement requires /calpha_rmsd_A <= 2 after one proper-rotation fit to all mapped, observed Cα positions in the first coordinate model. Require coverage of at least nine tenths of the mature chain for a near-whole-chain conclusion. Report every supplied map separately, including missing sites and maps of limited scope.
predictions.limitations: A static Cα fit addresses backbone placement. Side-chain accuracy and the occupancy of a state in a food matrix require other measurements. Prior training exposure is unknown.

lead_interpretation.rationale: The threshold precedes release of the experimental material. Coverage and agreement address distinct questions.
